title: 第159章 不要轻举妄动第158章 拿到两人受害视频
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
若非天机阁这时候派人来，他差点都要把天机阁忘了。
天机阁是干什么的？不就是占星测算吗？
说不定他们早就算出了天剑宗会发生这些事。
但他们为何不早些派人来？
若是早早来人，他们不就能提前预防，裴昭跟姜珊就不用死了。
可他又没办法去怪天机阁，因为在很多时候，即便他们算出来有什么不对，也不会去提醒别人，除非一些很小的事，又或者一些特别大的事，足以毁灭世界的那种。
“正是如此。”伯言微微颔首，“阁主让我代问宗主一句，前段时间天剑宗小公子满月宴，天机阁送来的贺礼，诸位是否还没看？”
宁雄霸闻言一愣：“嗯？”
他往左看看厚朴，又往右看看宝儿，“你们看了吗？”
难道说天机阁将提示藏在了贺礼里？
厚朴跟宝儿迎上他的眼神皆是一愣，都摇了摇头。
按正常流程来说，不管是谁，办什么宴，收到宾客送来礼物都不会马上查看，肯定是宴会结束，送走宾客，待到晚上才有时间细细清点。
而那天，满月宴还没开始，就收到了裴昭的人头，谁还有时间去看别人的礼物都送了什么。
现在那些锦盒还全在库房里堆着呢。
伯言一副早有预料的神色，继续说：“如今也不必看了，阁主正是料到诸位没看，才让我过来一趟。”
“阁主算出天剑宗即将倾巢而出，但诸位想赢，很难，让我建议诸位先不要轻举妄动。”
众人：“？？？”
啥意思啊这人？
他们还什么都没做呢，这人就来说他们要输？
他们不要面子的吗？

他们的骄傲是被别人放在地上踩的吗？
不信！
他们非要试试。
宁雄霸闻言，脸色在一瞬间沉了下去，“不知天机阁阁主还说了什么？伯言道友可否说得更为详细一些？”
他们打不过？
这一点让他这个一宗之主很难接受，杀害裴昭跟姜珊的人到底有多强？
难道他们即便有鹤隐舟这个天之骄子在也不行？
那鹤隐舟还算什么天之骄子？
“这……”伯言抿唇，“阁主就只说了这些，我在来的路上也想算一算，但我的道行还不够，算不出来其中内情。”
此言一出，众人沉默了下来。
若是已知接下来是一场死局，他们还会去吗？
这个问题萦绕在众人心头，但很快就得出了答案。
去，一定会去。
无非一死而已。
有些他们坚持的东西远比自己一条生命更加重要。
所以哪怕知道会失败，或许会死，那也一定要去，但他们会更努力，更谨慎，尽量确保大家都能全身而退。
大家都这么想，除了裴昭之外。
他喃喃地说：“要不咱们还是从长计议吧？”
就算是要报仇，那也不着急，等以后更强了再去也不迟嘛。
content_en:
If Tianji Pavilion hadn't sent someone here at this time, he would have almost forgotten about Tianji Pavilion.
What does Tianji Pavilion do? Isn't it just astrological calculation?
Maybe they had already figured out that these things would happen to Tianjian Sect.
But why didn't they send someone earlier?
If people had come earlier, they wouldn't have been able to take precautions in advance, and Pei Zhao and Jiang Shan wouldn't have died.
But he couldn't blame Tianji Pavilion, because in many cases, even if they figured out something was wrong, they would not remind others, unless it was something very small, or something extremely big that could destroy the world.
"Exactly." Boyan nodded slightly, "The master of the pavilion asked me to ask the sect master, have you not seen the congratulatory gifts sent by Tianji Pavilion to the young master of Tianjian Sect some time ago?"
Ning Xiongba was stunned when he heard this: "Huh?"
He looked to the left at Magnolia and then to the right at Bao'er, "Have you seen it?"
Could it be that Tianji Pavilion hid the reminder in the gift?
Houpu and Baoer were stunned when they met him, and both shook their heads.
According to normal procedures, no matter who it is or what kind of banquet it is, when guests receive gifts, they will not check them immediately. The banquet must be over, the guests have been sent away, and they will not have time to carefully count them until the evening.
On that day, before the full moon banquet started, Pei Zhao's head was received. Who had time to see what others had given as gifts?
Now those brocade boxes are still piled up in the warehouse.
Boyan looked like he had expected it, and continued: "There is no need to look now. The master of the pavilion asked me to come here just because he expected that you didn't look."
"The Pavilion Master has calculated that the Tianjian Sect is about to come out in force, but it will be difficult for you to win. Let me suggest that you don't act rashly."
Everyone: "???"
What do you mean, this guy?
They haven't done anything yet, and this person is telling them that they want to lose?
Don't they want to lose face?
Was their pride trampled on by others?
Don’t believe it!
They insisted on trying.
Upon hearing this, Ning Xiongba's face darkened for a moment, "I wonder what else the master of the Tianji Pavilion said? Can fellow Taoist Boyan give more details?"
They can't beat it?
This was hard for him, the head of a sect, to accept. How strong were the people who killed Pei Zhao and Jiang Shan?
Could it be that they couldn't do it even if He Yinzhou, the proud man of heaven, was here?
How can He Yinzhou be regarded as the proud man of heaven?
"This..." Boyan pursed his lips, "That's all the Pavilion Master said. I wanted to do the math on the way here, but I'm not good enough to figure out the inside story."
As soon as this was said, everyone fell silent.
If they knew it was going to be a dead end, would they still go?
The question lingered in everyone's mind, but the answer soon came to mind.
Go, will definitely go.
Nothing but death.
Some things they insist on are far more important than their own lives.
So even if they know they will fail or die, they still have to go, but they will work harder and be more cautious, trying to ensure that everyone can escape unscathed.
Everyone thinks so, except Pei Zhao.
He murmured: "How about we take a long-term approach?"
Even if you want to take revenge, there is no need to worry. It won’t be too late to wait until you are stronger.
